phrases.english: safe journey there and back (Plaut. Capt. 900)
phrases.source: Libellus VI, Reditus: per Alpēs domum

phrases.latin: tū intrō abī. — Bene ambulātō. — Bene valē.
phrases.english: You go inside. — Safe journey. — Goodbye.

phrases.latin: Bene ambulētis, et sit Deus in itinere vestrō, et angelus ejus comitētur vōbīscum.
phrases.english: Have a good journey, and God be on your way, and his angel go with you.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 212.

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
